h1: JLCCNC Launches Sheet Metal Fabrication Service

headings.text: JLCCNC Launches Sheet Metal Fabrication Service
What Makes JLCCNC Sheet Metal Fabrication Different?

meta_description: JLCCNC sheet metal service is live — fast, precise parts with finishes like anodizing, powder coating, and laser marking.
monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Launches Sheet Metal Fabrication Service JLCCNC Launches Sheet Metal Fabrication Service Product Update Nov 07, 2025 Table of Contents What Makes JLCCNC Sheet Metal Fabrication Different? Full Range of Surface Finishes Quality & Fast Delivery In Conclusion About JLCCNC Media Contact: We are thrilled to announce that JLCCNC's Sheet Metal Fabrication Service has officially launched after a successful one-month trial run! Thanks to the trust and support of our valued customers, we have smoothly transitioned from trial operation to full-scale production . Within just a month, our sheet metal service has gained recognition for its high precision, versatile material options, and refined surface finishing capabilities . What Makes JLCCNC Sheet Metal Fabrication Different? At JLCCNC, we combine precision, efficiency, and flexibility to deliver high-quality sheet metal parts — from prototypes to small-batch production. Our advanced sheet metal production line features CNC laser cutting machines, bending machines, punching machines, and welding stations , enabling us to process complex geometries with tight tolerances. We specialize in working with the following materials: Aluminum 5052 Stainless Steel 201 Stainless Steel 304 Cold Rolled Steel Galvanized Steel Sheet Whether it's structural enclosures, electronic housings, or custom brackets, our team ensures excellent fit, finish, and durability for every part. Full Range of Surface Finishes To meet both aesthetic and functional requirements, JLCCNC offers a comprehensive suite of surface treatments , including: Anodizing Hardcoat Anodizing Conductive Anodizing Powder Coating Brushing Silkscreen Printing Laser Marking With our online quoting system , you can preview each surface finish and get an instant quote — simply upload your file, select the finish, and receive your quote immediately . Minimum order price starts from $0.4 , making it flexible for all project sizes. Quality & Fast Delivery Just like our CNC services, quality and rapid delivery are our top priorities. Our inspection team uses precision measuring instruments, including 2D projectors, thickness gauges, and surface testers , to ensure every part meets strict standards before shipment. The fastest production cycle can be completed in just one day , providing you with highly efficient and convenient sheet metal services. In Conclusion The official launch of JLCCNC Sheet Metal Fabrication Service marks another milestone in our mission to deliver comprehensive, one-stop manufacturing solutions . We sincerely thank all our customers for their support! JLCCNC Sheet Metal Fabrication is now online — upload your design and get an instant quote! Minimum price $0.4, fastest lead time in 1 day! About JLCCNC JLCCNC is a trusted provider of precision CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, specializing in prototyping, small-batch production, and customized parts. With advanced equipment, versatile materials, and a full range of surface finishes, JLCCNC delivers high-quality, reliable parts with fast turnaround, empowering businesses and creators worldwide.
